main_text.p: Propheta captauerit. Syllogismi autem ueluti complexu, caufas quarum hæc mē tio eft facta, συλλήβδην[?] perstringemus.

Illud oraculum ἀξιομνημόνευτον[?] haberi, & summa cum attentione cognosci debet, quod diuinitus uero Prophetæ patefactum eft, & in quo agitur de grauissimis rebus populû Dei & eius hostes attinentibus.

Tale autem eft istud Onus, quod in uisione oblatum eft Habacuc Prophetæ. Etenim fi spectes eius causam efficientem principem, occurret Deus in cœlo, qui reuelat secreta: Dan.2.28.& 47. fi patefactionis formam, occurret uisio prophetica: de qua Num.12.6. Si fuerit Propheta uobis, ego Iehouah in uisione apparebo ei, in somnio loquar cū eo. fi materiam, occurret castigationum & poenarum diuinarum denuciatio. Amos 3.7. Quia nō facit Dominus Iehouah quicquam, nisi reuelauerit secretum suum seruis suis Prophetis. denique fi præconem, uelut organica causam spectes, occurret Habacuc Propheta fidelis, qui de impendentibus malis sic uaticinatus eft, ut ab omnibus γνησιολογίας ἢ ψιθυρολογίας[?] abstineret: mul-

page.notes: Greek words in the last two places (συλλήβδην, ἀξιομνημόνευτον, γνησιολογίας ἢ ψιθυρολογίας) are set in a small, worn face; their letters are doubtful and have been marked [?]. The word "tum" at the foot is the catchword for the following page and is not part of the running text. The printed "Amos 3.7." and "Dan.2.28.& 47." references are kept in the text as printed.
